description: This file implements utility functions for HTTP form content objects, including a factory function to create an instance of such an object. It is part of the HyperText Transfer Protocol implementation and appears to define a creation method for a specific HTTP form content component.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE HttpCreateFormContent(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HTTP form content object by invoking the internal factory function 'HttpFcoCreate', passing through provided context handles.
